reviews.title: My favorite case
reviews.comment: In spite of its price I will say that this in indeed my favorite case. One down side I will say that the included fans are 120mm and DC only, no PWM for them. However they do fit rather nicely on the bottom slots and there is an included splitter so you won't take up too many fan headers. Just make sure that the blades are pointed down and pull air INTO the case for better Graphics cooling.
